svg.text: Thin convenience layer over MongoDB Kotlin Coroutine Driver: no duplicate CRUD wrappers.

g.text: Runtime still belongs to MongoDB Kotlin Coroutine Driver: suspend CRUD and Flow-returning query APIs are not wrapped.
Factories, cached clients, focused extensions, BSON helpers, and ordered pipeline stage builders.
